newsitem.title: USA: Harleysville to buy Boyertown Mutual operations.
newsitem.headline: Harleysville to buy Boyertown Mutual operations.

text.p: Harleysville Mutual Insurance Co and Boyertown Mutual Insurance Co said they have reached an agreement for Harleysville to acquire Boyertown's operations for undisclosed terms.
Harleysville would assume responsibility for Boyertown's policies and operations, all of which are in Pennsylvania, pending state approval, the companies said in a joint statement.
In 1996, Boyertown wrote $5.4 million in direct written premiums in seven eastern Pennsylvania counties and is currently represented by approximately 130 agencies.
The transaction is expected to be complete by August 31, 1997.
